name: Ramesh Joshi (sample)
story: Third-generation painter working with hand-ground mineral pigments and squirrel-hair brushes on treated paper. A palm-sized piece takes about two weeks.

verified.evidence: Demo profile — real artisans must be verified (ID + craft certificate + workshop visit) before listing.

name: Meena Soni (sample)
story: Cuts and sets semi-precious stone into Makrana-style white marble. Small coasters take a day; a plate several weeks.

name: Sunil Chhipa (sample)
story: Carves teak printing blocks and prints cotton with vegetable and mineral dyes; each metre needs thousands of hand-stamped impressions.

name: Kavita Mehta (sample)
story: Paints temple-hanging style pichwai panels depicting Shrinathji, lotus ponds and cows, using gold leaf accents.

name: Gopal Lal Silversmith (sample)
story: Hammers and chases silver filigree jewellery and small decorative objects at a street-side bench near the palace gate.
